title: A gate whose question says rule is classed agents-rule only when it is about a rule-guarding file
goal: Retrospective of SP-wgx4pq4r: bl_authority's agents-rule pattern matches the bare word rule, so BG-47kw57ed's worker saw a design question about which distill rows count turn into a blocking operator gate, and reworded the question to get past it; likewise a question about the Sonnet 5.5 model release was classed push and answer --provisional was refused (ST-hcc7a3fd, SP-vayhvwfy). A gate on an item whose touches name no rule-guarding path is not classed agents-rule for the word rule alone, only when its touches or text name a rule-guarding path or file (gate g1); the word release classes push only beside another push or kb word in the gate's text (gate g2), the other push words as they are; a gate the pattern does class names the matched words, kb/_self/backlog.md says so, and the authority tests pass.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_authority as a; c=lambda q,t=[]: a.class_reasons({"touches":t},{"id":"g1","question":q,"options":["yes","no"]})[0]; assert c("Which distill rows count by rule?",["kb/public/x.md"])!="agents-rule"; assert c("How is the Sonnet 5.5 release question dispositioned?")!="push"; assert c("Do we push to origin?")=="push"; assert c("Which rule does AGENTS.md carry?")=="agents-rule"; assert c("Which rule?",[".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md"])=="agents-rule"

rule is dropped from the words; only the file, skill and agent definition words and the touches class it

gates.answer: rule classes agents-rule only when the item's touches or the gate's text name a rule-guarding path or file

gates.question: When does the bare word release class a gate push, once the quoted-subject case is narrowed?
options: release classes push only beside another push or kb word in the gate's text (push, publish, tag, branch, remote, origin, github, gitlab, mirror, upload, deploy, merge request, kb, note)
release keeps classing push whenever the word appears, and only rule is narrowed
